info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Data Information Provider Status API
info.description: The Market Data Information Provider Status API offers real-time insights into the operational status of the various information providers within the banking ecosystem. By querying this API, clients can monitor and verify the availability and health of different market data feeds, ensuring seamless integration into financial applications. Typical consumers include traders, risk management teams, and financial analysts seeking reliable and up-to-date market information. This API is crucial for maintaining operational transparency and supporting decision-making processes.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of the information provider operation.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of the information provider operation, providing insights into its operational state and functionality.

200.description: The request was successful, and the current status of the information provider operation is returned.
